task.title: naturalday names weekdays for dates within six days
task.body:
Why: https://github.com/python-humanize/humanize/issues/102 ; src/humanize/time.py naturalday names only yesterday, today and tomorrow and prints a month and day for everything else.
Outcome: `humanize.naturalday(value, format="%b %d", weekday=False)` takes a new keyword parameter `weekday` (bool, default False). With `weekday=True` a date 2 to 6 days in the past is 'last <Weekday>' and a date 2 to 6 days in the future is 'this <Weekday>', with the English weekday name (Monday ... Sunday); yesterday, today and tomorrow keep their words and every other date is formatted with `format`. With today 2026-11-14 (a Saturday): `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 12), weekday=True) == 'last Thursday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 8), weekday=True) == 'last Sunday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 16), weekday=True) == 'this Monday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 20), weekday=True) == 'this Friday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 7), weekday=True) == 'Nov 07'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 21), weekday=True) == 'Nov 21'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 13), weekday=True) == 'yesterday'`. With `weekday` left False nothing changes: `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 12)) == 'Nov 12'`.
Proof: add tests to tests/test_time.py using freeze_time.

spec: `humanize.naturalday(value, format="%b %d", weekday=False)` takes a new keyword parameter `weekday` (bool, default False). With `weekday=True` a date 2 to 6 days in the past is 'last <Weekday>' and a date 2 to 6 days in the future is 'this <Weekday>', with the English weekday name (Monday ... With today 2026-11-14 (a Saturday): `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 12), weekday=True) == 'last Thursday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 8), weekday=True) == 'last Sunday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 16), weekday=True) == 'this Monday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 20), weekday=True) == 'this Friday'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 7), weekday=True) == 'Nov 07'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 21), weekday=True) == 'Nov 21'`, `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 13), weekday=True) == 'yesterday'`. With `weekday` left False nothing changes: `naturalday(dt.date(2026, 11, 12)) == 'Nov 12'`.
install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q babel -e '.[tests]' && .venv/bin/pybabel --quiet compile --directory src/humanize/locale --domain humanize
